card.name: Digits inside phone and ID numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a longer digit string, such as a phone number, NDC code, ISBN or large figure with separators. It fires most often on the digit just after a hyphen or comma.

modes.label: Phone and ID numbers
modes.description: A digit partway through a hyphenated phone, NDC or ISBN number.

modes.label: Large figures
modes.description: A digit inside a long number with commas or currency.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a long number, like a phone number, product code or large figure.
